why_ai: Licensed therapists treat patients personally; the therapeutic relationship is the product and carries liability.
why_clarity: Recovery is gradual and hard to measure; clinicians apply protocols differently case by case.
why_digital: Sessions are conversations held in local offices or by telehealth, bought through local payer networks.

why_ai: Payers and states require accreditation from these named bodies, whose surveyors inspect programmes on site.
why_clarity: Written standards and codified survey procedures recur, but findings only cycle every three years.
why_digital: Standards work is documentary, but surveys happen on site and buyers are domestic programmes.

why_ai: Policy buyers pay for a credible firm's name on contested studies; AI accelerates the analysis itself.
why_clarity: Each commissioned study frames a new question and its conclusions are tested slowly through policy.
why_digital: Claims data in, report out, all screen work bought by national clients remotely.

why_ai: Template and reporting content bundled into software is exactly what AI-native EHRs will generate.
why_clarity: Templates and state reporting configurations are defined artefacts checked against published rules.
why_digital: Regulatory documents in, software content out, built entirely on screens.

why_ai: Physician medical directors sign criteria and denials, but most analytics and reporting automate readily.
why_clarity: Regulators define recurring parity and adequacy reports, though necessity criteria involve contested clinical judgment.
why_digital: Claims and authorization data analysed on screens, delivered as criteria and reports.

why_ai: Internal productivity and payer-mix analytics carry no licence and are prime AI automation targets.
why_clarity: Productivity benchmarks recur monthly, but acquisition models depend on each deal's specifics.
why_digital: Practice and claims data modelled on screens, delivered as dashboards and deal models.

why_ai: Licensed clinicians handle crisis, walk-in and court-ordered clients in person, funded by state mandates.
why_clarity: Safety-net clients have complex co-occurring needs and outcomes show up slowly, if ever.
why_digital: Walk-in crisis care delivered face to face to local clients under county contracts.

why_ai: Repetitive document submission to payer portals carries no licence and is directly automatable.
why_clarity: Enrolled or rejected is binary and repeats per clinician per payer, though approvals take months.
why_digital: Documents and portals dominate, with residual faxes and phone calls to payer departments.

why_ai: NCQA-certified CVOs are accountable for verification accuracy, but verification itself is rote automation.
why_clarity: Primary source verification follows a codified checklist with checkable results across thousands of files.
why_digital: Licence and sanction records verified online and delivered as electronic credentialing files.

why_ai: The DSM's value is the APA's institutional authority, which no AI can confer.
why_clarity: Diagnostic categories are contested by expert consensus and revised once a decade.
why_digital: Evidence review and publishing are documentary, with workgroups and print editions sold nationally.

why_ai: Outcomes and ROI analytics are unlicensed data science that AI tools increasingly perform.
why_clarity: Symptom scales are measurable, but ROI claims are contested and validated over plan years.
why_digital: Symptom scores and claims analysed on screens, delivered as reports to remote employer buyers.

why_ai: Congress mandates the official national survey series; nobody can substitute an AI estimate for it.
why_clarity: Survey methodology is codified and annual, but estimates have no quick ground truth.
why_digital: Household field interviews feed screen analysis, published online, funded only through federal procurement.

why_ai: Constraint matching of patients to clinicians is a structured scheduling task software can absorb.
why_clarity: Every intake recurs with clear constraints, though matching logic lives in one coordinator's head.
why_digital: Phone calls and forms feed spreadsheet matching, delivered as a booked appointment.

why_ai: State-mandated ASAM criteria derive authority from the publisher's name and statutory adoption.
why_clarity: Criteria dimensions are written down, but editions are rare and validity studies slow.
why_digital: Editorial research produces a publication and licensed software sold nationally to payers and providers.

why_ai: Licensed clinicians deliver therapy personally and patients stay for the specific therapist.
why_clarity: Therapy outcomes are gradual and clinician-specific despite rule-heavy scheduling around them.
why_digital: Hybrid office and telehealth sessions sold through local payer networks and referrals.

why_ai: Patients seek a licensed clinician sharing their language and culture; that match is the product.
why_clarity: Validated instruments are missing for many languages, so assessment relies on clinician adaptation.
why_digital: Conversational care delivered in offices or video to local immigrant communities.

why_ai: Regulators adversarially reject analyses, but LLMs will draft much of the comparative document.
why_clarity: Regulators frequently reject analyses because no agreed method for proving NQTL parity exists.
why_digital: Plan documents in, a written analysis out, produced entirely on screens.

why_ai: Trial sponsors buy endpoint reliability under GCP, but scoring surveillance is pattern analysis AI handles.
why_clarity: Rater certification is codified, but whether rating quality saved a trial emerges years later.
why_digital: Recorded ratings and score data analysed remotely for global pharma sponsors.

why_ai: Decades of irreplaceable standardization samples and court-defensible brands protect these instruments.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified, but each instrument is a multi-year one-off project.
why_digital: Norms come from in-person test administration, delivered as kits and digital scoring sold nationally.

why_ai: Licensed clinicians work on school premises with minors under FERPA and HIPAA duties.
why_clarity: Student outcomes are slow and blurred by school calendars breaking continuity of care.
why_digital: Therapy happens in person inside schools under local district contracts.

why_ai: Licensed prescribers dispense controlled MAT medication and run in-person groups and residential care.
why_clarity: ASAM criteria codify placement and groups recur daily, but recovery outcomes emerge slowly.
why_digital: Bodies, medications and drug screens handled on site, with patients referred locally or regionally.

why_ai: Licensed therapists still carry liability, but screen-only care competes directly with AI therapy apps.
why_clarity: Therapy progress is gradual and judged differently by each clinician.
why_digital: Care is delivered fully by video, though state licensure blocks providers from abroad.
